summary: not-th.re is a straightforward paste sharing application designed for text and code snippets. It incorporates client-side encryption to secure data before transmission and integrates the Monaco code editor directly into the browser interface. The platform is packaged as a Docker container using Node.js.
goodFor: It suits users looking for a self-hosted pastebin with built-in code editing capabilities and client-side privacy controls.
watchOut: The project exhibits low maintenance activity and competes in a crowded category with much more established alternatives.
deployNotes: You will typically need to run the container behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination, and ensure persistent volumes are configured if data retention is required.
